entities.title: A room is gone a day after its last change
entities.summary: Rooms keep no history: a room nobody has changed for 24 hours deletes its storage, names and scores included, and its link stops working.
entities.impact: An old link, say one still in a Teams chat, says the game no longer exists; the host starts a new room and shares the new link.

entities.title: Knowing a room's code is enough to join it
entities.summary: Joining needs no sign-in: anyone with the link or the five letters may take a free seat, up to ten players.
entities.impact: A link that travels further than intended lets strangers in; the host can remove them (once any round they are playing is over), but nothing stops them joining again under another name.
entities.workaround: Start a new room and share its link only with the intended players.
